title: Serre's conditions (R_k) and (S_k)
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $k\ge0$ an integer. For a prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ let $R_{\mathfrak p}$ be the localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})$ its Krull dimension (the height of $\mathfrak p$) and $\operatorname{depth}(R_{\mathfrak p})$ its depth as a module over itself [def-weil-pbc-depth]. (1) $R$ has property *$(R_k)$* (is regular in codimension $\le k$) if for every prime $\mathfrak p$ of height $\le k$ the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. (2) $R$ has property *$(S_k)$* if for every prime $\mathfrak p$ the local ring $R_{\mathfrak p}$ has $\operatorname{depth}(R_{\mathfrak p})\ge\min\{k,\dim(R_{\mathfrak p})\}$.
